messages:
AcmeInc (Prod): Hey, we started getting a bunch of 403s hitting /v1/generate this morning. Same curl we use in prod, same API key. Example: 

AcmeInc (Prod): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live_XXXXX"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-4","input":"hello"}'
```

Maya (Support): Sorry about that — I can see the 403s in our logs for your org id 67890. Can you confirm whether you changed plans/features recently? Also sending to eng to triage.

AcmeInc (Prod): No plan change, billing is current. We get a JSON body that just says `{"error":"Forbidden"}` which is super unhelpful. Our client assumes the key is wrong and prompts users to re-auth.

Sam (Eng): I pulled the trace. Requests are hitting auth OK (API key validated) but then entitlement middleware returns 403 when the feature flag for `llm-generation` is evaluated. The issue: response body is generic and our SDK surfaces it as an auth failure.

Ethan (SRE): Pasted relevant log snippet: 

```
[2026-05-18T08:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 org=67890 api_key=sk-live_XXXXX auth=OK entitlement=DENIED feature=llm-generation reason=plan_missing_flag status=403
```

Maya (Support): So entitlement check is the cause, not auth. Can we return a clearer error to the client? Customer confusion causes a lot of support churn.

Sam (Eng): Agreed. Current flow returns HTTP 403 for both auth failures and entitlement denies, with a terse `Forbidden`. Propose changing the entitlement path to return structured body like: 

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "entitlement_denied",
  "reason": "plan_missing_feature",
  "feature": "llm-generation",
  "details": "Upgrade to Pro plan or enable feature flag. Contact billing@redwood.example"
}
```

This keeps 403 status but gives clear machine-readable code and human message. SDK can map `entitlement_denied` -> show upgrade flow instead of 'invalid key'.

Aisha (Billing): If we ship this, we should include a link to the self-serve upgrade page and internal product code so support can see why the deny happened. Also we need to ensure we aren't leaking plan names in prod logs to customers. The `details` text should be safe.

Sam (Eng): Good point. Use `support_url` and a short `support_code` instead: 

```
{
  "error": "entitlement_denied",
  "reason": "plan_missing_feature",
  "feature": "llm-generation",
  "support_url": "https://redwood.example/support/entitlement-help",
  "support_code": "E-ENT-67890"
}
```

Maya (Support): Can we do a quick patch behind a feature flag and roll to canary? We should update the SDK to detect `entitlement_denied` and surface a dedicated error class.

Sam (Eng): I'll open a PR with a small change in the middleware to populate `error_code` and `support_code` when entitlement denies. Patch: 

```
# pseudo
if (!entitlement.allowed) {
  return json(403, {
    error: 'entitlement_denied',
    reason: entitlement.reason, // e.g. 'plan_missing_feature'
    feature: entitlement.feature,
    support_code: gen_support_code(req.org, 'ENT')
  })
}
```
I'll gate behind `entitlement-clarity` feature flag and roll to 5% canary.

deploy-bot: Deployed entitlement-clarity=on to canary (5%) at 2026-05-18T09:01:22Z :rocket:

Ethan (SRE): Monitoring note: watch 5xx rate and customer error surface. Also add a short log annotation so support can find the support_code quickly.

AcmeInc (Prod): Any ETA? We're still having users confused and wasting time prompting re-auth flows.

Maya (Support): ETA for canary verification ~30m, if stable we'll ramp to 100% in next 2 hours and update you. Meanwhile workaround: add tag `X-Entitlement-Bypass: true`? (not recommended) Better: ask your account manager for `llm-generation` enablement; I can expedite a temporary enable for your org while we roll.

AcmeInc (Prod): Please expedite temporary enable, that would unblock us. Also thanks for the clearer error plan — that will help a lot.

Aisha (Billing): I approved a temporary enable for org 67890 for 24h. Note: this will not retroactively fix SDK behavior but will stop the 403s.

Sam (Eng): Canary looks healthy: no spike in 500s, sample responses show the new body. Will start ramping to 25% then 100% after a thumbs-up.

Maya (Support): Action items: 1) Sam -> merge patch & ramp 2) Eng SDK -> add entitlement_denied mapping 3) Support -> notify customer and attach support_code when they hit error 4) Billing -> confirm temporary enable done.

AcmeInc (Prod): Confirmed temporary enable in place, 403s cleared. Thanks team. :tada:

Sam (Eng): Will create follow-up ticket to roll out better metric tagging and add an internal KB entry explaining the difference between auth vs entitlement 403s and how to reproduce.

Maya (Support): KB draft: how to reproduce: 
```
1) Use a valid key for an org without feature flag.
2) POST /v1/generate -> receive 403 with error_code 'entitlement_denied' and support_code.
3) Use support_code to look up org in support console -> shows missing feature plan flag.
```

Maya (Support): Closing loop for this thread — customer unblocked, patch rolling, SDK task created. Will update when fully rolled. :white_check_mark:
